capture_filing_state_valid.name: capture_filing_state_valid
capture_filing_state_valid.value: ("capture"."state" = 'unfiled' and "capture"."filed_at" is null and "capture"."filed_record_kind" is null and "capture"."filed_record_id" is null) or ("capture"."state" = 'filed' and "capture"."filed_at" is not null and "capture"."project_id" is not null and "capture"."filed_record_kind" in ('task', 'note') and "capture"."filed_record_id" is not null)
